title: Demo store mutations are discarded — `let _ = next` throws away the updated store at every write site
evidence:
+                      let #(next, demo_eff) =
+                        demo_api.mark_application_opened(
+                          demo_store_of(model),
...
+                      let _ = next
+                      demo_eff

and

+      let #(next, eff) =
+        demo_api.create_vacancy(
+          demo_store_of(model),
...
+      let _ = next
+      eff

plus model.gleam: "+    // `demo_store` is the pure MVU state seeded from the fixtures on /demo" and the inline comment "+                  // demo: the store idempotently moves Submitted -> UnderReview."
detail: DemoStore is documented as pure MVU state, yet every demo write (mark_application_opened, create_vacancy, update_vacancy x2) binds the returned store to `next` and discards it; model.demo_store is never updated, so mutations cannot persist to subsequent reads.
recommended_fix: Thread the returned store into the model (e.g. have demo_api return a Msg that stores `next`, or perform the store update in update via demo_update.handle) instead of `let _ = next`.

title: Exiting demo to a public route drops auth to NotAsked with no session restore and leaves the demo CSRF token
evidence:
+        _, True ->
+          case is_public_route(route) {
+            True ->
+              handle_browser_change(
+                Model(
+                  ..model,
+                  demo_mode: False,
+                  demo_store: None,
+                  auth: NotAsked,
+                ),
+                uri,
+                route,
+              )

vs the non-demo init path which includes "+        auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession),". enter_demo sets "+          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token"," which this exit branch does not clear.
detail: A logged-in landlord who visits /demo has model.auth overwritten with the mock landlord; on exit to Landing/Login the SPA keeps auth NotAsked and never re-runs check_session, so they appear logged out (and carry the literal demo CSRF token) until a full page reload.
recommended_fix: On demo exit, dispatch auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) alongside handle_browser_change and reset csrf_token to "".

detail: view_page handles Demo before the protected-route fallback and is_protected_route lists Demo in the False branch, so the `routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)` arm inside view_protected_page can never render — two divergent Demo render paths exist, one dead.

title: routes.Dashboard arm in demo_entry_effects is unreachable; navigating to /demo mid-demo silently re-seeds
evidence:
+fn demo_entry_effects(store: DemoStore, route: Route) -> Effect(Msg) {
+  let base = [demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications)]
+  let route_eff = case route {
+    routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> [
+      demo_api.list_vacancies(store, ApiReturnedDashboardData),
+    ]

with doc "+/// The fetches a fresh demo entry needs for its route: dashboard + bell for
+/// the demo root, the route's own data for a deep-linked demo route."

and call sites: "+  case is_demo_route(route) {" (init; Dashboard yields False via is_demo_route's "_ -> False") and "+        routes.Demo, _ -> enter_demo(model, route)" (BrowserChangedUrl, Demo only).
detail: enter_demo is only ever called with routes.Demo or an is_demo_route deep link, so the Dashboard alternative in demo_entry_effects is dead; separately, `routes.Demo, _ -> enter_demo(...)` re-seeds the store even when already in demo, so any link to /demo silently wipes demo state.
recommended_fix: Drop the Dashboard alternative from demo_entry_effects, and guard the BrowserChangedUrl Demo arm (e.g. skip re-seed when model.demo_mode is already True) or document the reset-on-/demo behaviour.
